SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS "orders.size_class",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _cm__count AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.grain_d7cf5d2d" AS "grain_d7cf5d2d",
    _stage_inner."orders.order_date_month" AS "order_date_month",
    _stage_inner."orders._count" AS "_count"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS "orders.grain_d7cf5d2d",
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date_month",
      COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
    FROM orders AS orders
    WHERE
      (
        orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
      )
    GROUP BY
      CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_orders___sum_partition_by_order_date AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.order_date_month" AS "orders.order_date_month",
    SUM(_base._v) AS "orders.sum__count"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date_month",
      CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS _ek0,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS _ek1,
      MAX(COALESCE(_cm__count."_count", 0)) AS _v
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN _cm__count
      ON CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm__count."grain_d7cf5d2d"
      AND DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm__count."order_date_month"
    WHERE
      (
        orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
      )
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date),
      CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."orders.order_date_month"
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.size_class",
    _base."orders.order_date",
    _base."orders.n",
    _base."orders.n" / _cm_orders___sum_partition_by_order_date."orders.sum__count" AS "orders.share",
    _cm_orders___sum_partition_by_order_date."orders.sum__count" AS "orders.sum__count"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_orders___sum_partition_by_order_date
    ON _base."orders.order_date" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders___sum_partition_by_order_date."orders.order_date_month"
), shifted__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS "orders.size_class",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), sjoin__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    base."orders.size_class",
    base."orders.order_date",
    base."orders.n",
    base."orders.share",
    base."orders.sum__count",
    shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.n" AS "orders._time_shift_inner"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted__time_shift_inner
    ON base."orders.size_class" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.size_class"
    AND base."orders.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.order_date"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.size_class",
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.n",
    "orders.share",
    "orders.sum__count",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.n" - "orders._time_shift_inner" AS "orders.chg"
  FROM sjoin__time_shift_inner
)
SELECT
  "orders.size_class",
  "orders.order_date",
  "orders.n",
  "orders.share",
  "orders.chg"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.size_class",
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.n",
    "orders.share",
    "orders.sum__count",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.chg"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.order_date" ASC,
  "orders.size_class" ASC
LIMIT 21
